evidence: A rustic user and contributor recommends Glacier Deep Archive cold storage, explicitly advising secondary-backup use rather than routine restores.

evidence_sources.author: pmw
evidence_sources.excerpt: I heartily recommend rustic's cold storage support for Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. It ends up being $1/TB/month, as long as you plan to not restore from it. (Use it as a secondary backup, and plan to restore from your primary.) I have been using rustic+GDA for about a year now, and I contributed some enhancements to this software ecosystem to make this path smooth for others.

source_story_title: Fujifilm to boost tape production 5x as AI fuels archiving demand
